The assistant’s answer does not address the problem correctly. It incorrectly assumes the arrays must be the same length, re‑sorts the arrays (which violates the O(n) time requirement), and computes a median that is not the true median of the combined arrays. The solution also misstates the time complexity (claiming O(n) while actually performing O(n log n) work). Overall, the response is inaccurate, incomplete, and not helpful.

Rating: [[2]]
